reason: At ₹12,990 flat per year for up to 5 seats with no per-user nickeling or setup fees, it covers our whole partnership affordably, and letting clients keep sending files on WhatsApp solves my morning triage across 30 client groups.
objection: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp, so I worry my staff will still have to spend time manually forwarding and organizing every single document.
